description: This file declares the class AdbWinUsbIOCompletion, which encapsulates a wrapper around the OVERLAPPED structure used for asynchronous I/O operations via the WinUsb API in the Android USB host implementation on Windows. It includes class methods for managing overlapped I/O completion, resource release, and obtaining I/O results.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
classes.description: Wrapper around OVERLAPPED structure for asynchronous WinUsb API I/O, managing resource lifetime and providing I/O result retrieval.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with parent I/O object, expected transfer size, and event handle.

methods.name: ~AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Protected destructor, hidden to prevent stack allocation, ensuring proper heap release.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the object, decrements reference count, and deletes object when count reaches zero, ensuring deletion in the module's heap.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an overlapped I/O operation using WinUsb_GetOverlappedResult, optionally waiting.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbEndpointObject * parent_winusb_io_object() const
methods.description: Returns the parent WinUsb endpoint object associated with this I/O completion object.
